menus.note: For two or more; served 6pm to 11pm. Beverage pairing AED 738. Caviar with the Peking duck AED 400 extra.

alsoTry.name: Chi at Hakkasan
alsoTry.note: Two cocktails and six dim sum (AED 288 with two glasses of Champagne), Sunday to Thursday 6pm to 8pm.

bookingOpens: Online through SevenRooms, or by phone. Dinner is served Tuesday to Saturday, 6pm to 11:30pm (bar until 12:30am); closed on Sundays and Mondays.
groups: The semi-private area of the main dining room seats up to 20 and the lounge up to 40; enquire by phone or through the private events form.
